correctness.rationale: For Haar random plane normal, x=|U·e_3| is uniform [0,1] and y=sqrt(1−x²); orthogonal cylinder shadow is ellipse of axes r,rx Minkowski-added to an axial segment length hy, hence A=πr²x+2rhy, P=4rE(1−x²)+2hy. Beta integrals yield E[x]=1/2, E[y]=π/4, E[xy]=1/3, E[y²]=2/3; exchanging elliptic integrals yields E[E]=π²/8 and E[xE]=2/3; weighted I=E[yE]. These reconstruct E[AP]=(8π/3)r³+(2π/3+8I)r²h+(8/3)rh² and the covariance quadratic r³[4C(h/r)²+B(h/r)+4πC]. The 144-term rational hypergeometric truncation plus tail and Machin arctangent enclosure gives 0.930<I<0.933, C>0.0498, −0.69<B<−0.65, B²<(0.69)²<64(3.14)(0.0498)²<64πC²; discriminant negative with C>0 and vertex h/r=−B/(8C)>0. Independent high-precision integral gives I≈0.9318171570247627, minimizer≈1.68126868048556, minimum≈0.06275436161117 r³; finite polygonal tests are only geometric sanity checks, not universal proof.
